what: br-zrat: a level Postie Bike placed with its centreline exactly on a heightfield grid line (x = 20 m on the flat strips' 10 m grid) settles on its wheels. parry 0.31.1 dropped a straight-down ray on a cell edge, so both suspension rays missed and the bike fell 0.44 m onto its hull; the vendored repair (vendor/parry3d/JAMMERS-PATCH.md) tests the neighbouring cells, natively and in WASM alike.
